prompt:
Use the supplied Concept02/16.png sheet as the identity reference for operative 16, Datum. Reproduce its left full-body character as ONE isolated figure for experimental TRELLIS.2 input, preserving the existing suit design.

Retain the closed segmented gunmetal helmet, opaque black visor, angular chin guard and existing side computer housing; conceal all skin, face and eyes. Preserve the single polygonal breastplate, exactly three abdominal lames, shoulder caps, forearm guards, thigh plates, knee guards, shin armor, utility belt and pouches, gloves and lace-up boots. Match the charcoal and muted olive fabric, restrained metal wear, fasteners, straps, armor thickness and mobile human proportions. Keep the reference's practical 2043 MERIDIAN equipment logic and realistic material detail.

Pose the character in a relaxed symmetric A-pose: arms approximately 25 degrees away from the torso, elbows nearly straight, empty gloved hands relaxed and clearly separated from the thighs. Separate the legs comfortably, keep both feet fully visible and the head upright, aligned with the torso. Maintain clear negative space beneath both arms and between the legs. Use a near-frontal view with a slight 10-degree three-quarter turn, an eye-level long-lens camera and minimal perspective distortion.

Center the complete figure from helmet crown to boot soles with comfortable clear margins. Render at the highest realistic quality with balanced soft neutral lighting that reveals dark surfaces. Use a true transparent background with clean edges, no ground or drop shadow. Exclude additional figures or views, close-ups, HUD insets, text, labels, borders, weapons, new equipment and checkerboard graphics.
